author: FunBookies

max.name: Max

mom.name: Mom

story_bible.premise: A playful pup enjoys getting muddy outside, then needs a bath to get clean.
story_bible.setting: Sunny backyard with mud puddles and cozy bathroom with bathtub
story_bible.visual_style: Warm watercolor with soft edges and bright, cheerful colors

reference_prompt: 9-PANEL STYLE REFERENCE SHEET: Row 1: Small golden retriever puppy with floppy ears and big brown eyes (front view), same puppy with happy expression, same puppy in action pose jumping. Row 2: Brown mud puddle, white bathtub with soap bubbles, woman with brown hair in ponytail and gentle smile. Row 3: Sunny green backyard with garden area, cozy bathroom with white bathtub and warm lighting, close-up of puppy and woman hugging scene. Warm watercolor style with soft edges throughout.

pages.text: Max is a pup. He runs in the sun.
pages.scene: Wide shot: Small golden retriever puppy with floppy ears running across green backyard. Bright sunny morning light.

pages.text: Max sees mud. The mud is wet.
pages.scene: Medium shot: Golden puppy looking down at large brown mud puddle near garden. Excited posture with tail up.

pages.text: Max hops in the mud. He digs and runs.
pages.scene: Medium shot: Muddy golden puppy jumping and playing in brown mud puddle. Mud splashing around his paws.

pages.text: Max got mud on his fur. Mud is on his nose too.
pages.scene: Close-up: Golden puppy now covered in brown mud patches. Big brown eyes visible, mud splattered on nose and ears.

pages.text: The mud is fun. Max runs and hops more.
pages.scene: Wide shot: Very muddy golden puppy running and jumping in backyard. Brown mud covering most of his golden fur.

pages.text: Mom sees Max. She sees the mud too.
pages.scene: Medium shot: Woman with brown ponytail looking at extremely muddy puppy in backyard. Her hands on hips, gentle expression.

pages.text: Mom gets the tub. She fills it up.
pages.scene: Medium shot: Woman in bathroom filling white bathtub with water. Steam rising from warm water.

pages.text: Max gets in the tub. The water is hot.
pages.scene: Medium shot: Muddy golden puppy stepping into white bathtub filled with warm soapy water. Steam visible.

pages.text: Mom rubs Max with soap. The mud runs off.
pages.scene: Close-up: Woman's gentle hands washing golden puppy with white soap bubbles. Brown muddy water swirling away.

pages.text: Mom rubs Max more. His fur gets clean.
pages.scene: Medium shot: Woman washing golden puppy in bathtub. Puppy's fur returning to bright golden color, lots of white bubbles.

pages.text: Max is wet but clean. His fur is soft.
pages.scene: Medium shot: Clean golden puppy standing in bathtub, fur wet and golden again. Mom holding soft towel ready.

pages.text: Mom hugs Max. He is her good pup.
pages.scene: Close-up: Woman with brown ponytail hugging clean, fluffy golden puppy. Both smiling, warm bathroom lighting around them.
